summary: Noah Holdings filed a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, detailing routine share buybacks on the NYSE. The issuer repurchased ADSs representing ordinary shares at prices between ~$1.975–$2.243 per ADS (i.e., ~$0.395–$0.449 per ordinary share) on various dates from December 2025 to January 2026, all under a repurchase mandate approved at the June 2025 AGM. Shares are held for cancellation but not yet cancelled as of May 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is cited. The filing confirms an ongoing capital return program; watch for further buybacks or potential cancellation completion.
